# GENERATED FILE. DO NOT EDIT.
# Source: tools/auto_upgrade_buildings_data.py

aub_start_global_loop_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = aub_auto_build_loop_started } }
		set_global_variable = { name = aub_auto_build_loop_started value = 1 }
		trigger_event = { id = auto_build.0005 days = 1 }
	}
}

aub_pay_building_cost_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= $COST$ } }
		scope:aub_payer = { remove_short_term_treasury = $COST$ }
	}
	else = {
		scope:aub_payer = { remove_short_term_gold = $COST$ }
	}
}

# Caravanserai
aub_upgrade_caravanserai_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= expensive_building_tier_2_cost }
				scope:aub_payer = { gold >= expensive_building_tier_2_cost }
			}
			has_building = caravanserai_01
			scope:aub_payer.culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_guilds
			}
			building_requirement_castle_city_church = { LEVEL = 01 }
		}
		add_building = caravanserai_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = caravanserai_02 }
			aub_pay_building_cost_effect = { COST = expensive_building_tier_2_cost }

			scope:aub_payer.culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_city_planning
			}
		}
		add_building = breweries_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = breweries_02 }
			aub_pay_building_cost_effect = { COST = normal_building_tier_2_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= normal_building_tier_3_cost }
				scope:aub_payer = { gold >= normal_building_tier_3_cost }
			}
			has_building = breweries_02
			scope:aub_payer.culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_city_planning
			}
		}
		add_building = breweries_03
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = breweries_03 }
			aub_pay_building_cost_effect = { COST = normal_building_tier_3_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= normal_building_tier_4_cost }
				scope:aub_payer = { gold >= normal_building_tier_4_cost }
			}
			has_building = breweries_03
			scope:aub_payer.culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_manorialism
			}
		}
		add_building = breweries_04
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = breweries_04 }
			aub_pay_building_cost_effect = { COST = normal_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= normal_building_tier_5_cost }
				scope:aub_payer = { gold >= normal_building_tier_5_cost }
			}
			has_building = breweries_04
			scope:aub_payer.culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_windmills
			}
		}
		add_building = breweries_05
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = breweries_05 }
			aub_pay_building_cost_effect = { COST = normal_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= normal_building_tier_6_cost }
				scope:aub_payer = { gold >= normal_building_tier_6_cost }
			}
			has_building = breweries_05
			scope:aub_payer.culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_windmills
			}
		}
		add_building = breweries_06
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = breweries_06 }
			aub_pay_building_cost_effect = { COST = normal_building_tier_6_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= normal_building_tier_7_cost }
				scope:aub_payer = { gold >= normal_building_tier_7_cost }
			}
			has_building = breweries_06
			scope:aub_payer.culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_cranes
			}
		}
		add_building = breweries_07
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = breweries_07 }
			aub_pay_building_cost_effect = { COST = normal_building_tier_7_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= normal_building_tier_8_cost }
				scope:aub_payer = { gold >= normal_building_tier_8_cost }
			}
			has_building = breweries_07
			scope:aub_payer.culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_cranes
			}
		}
		add_building = breweries_08
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = breweries_08 }
			aub_pay_building_cost_effect = { COST = normal_building_tier_8_cost }
		}
	}
}

# Capital Bureau
aub_upgrade_capital_bureau_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= normal_building_tier_2_cost }
				scope:aub_payer = { gold >= normal_building_tier_2_cost }
			}
			has_building = capital_bureau_01
			scope:aub_payer.culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_city_planning
			}
			building_requirement_castle_city_church = { LEVEL = 01 }
			scope:aub_payer = {
				government_has_flag = government_is_administrative
			}
		}
		add_building = capital_bureau_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = capital_bureau_02 }
			aub_pay_building_cost_effect = { COST = normal_building_tier_2_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= normal_building_tier_3_cost }
				scope:aub_payer = { gold >= normal_building_tier_3_cost }
			}
			has_building = capital_bureau_02
			scope:aub_payer.culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_manorialism
			}
			building_requirement_castle_city_church = { LEVEL = 02 }
			scope:aub_payer = {
				government_has_flag = government_is_administrative
			}
		}
		add_building = capital_bureau_03
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = capital_bureau_03 }
			aub_pay_building_cost_effect = { COST = normal_building_tier_3_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= normal_building_tier_4_cost }

			}
		}
		add_building = capital_bureau_05
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = capital_bureau_05 }
			aub_pay_building_cost_effect = { COST = normal_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:aub_payer = { treasury >= normal_building_tier_6_cost }
				scope:aub_payer = { gold >= normal_building_tier_6_cost }
